Salesforce Developer
Overview

We are looking for a Salesforce Developer to join our team and support government and enterprise customers in their digital transformation journey. You will be responsible for the customization, extension, and integration of Salesforce, delivering solutions tailored to customer-specific requirements across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or other Salesforce modules.

If you're passionate about solving real-world problems through scalable Salesforce solutions and have strong hands-on development skills, we’d love to hear from you.

Experience & Skills Required
Key Responsibilities:
Work closely with customers, business analysts, and architects to understand requirements and translate them into technical designs
Develop custom Salesforce components using Apex, LWC, Visualforce, SOQL, and Flow
Customize standard and custom objects, workflows, approval processes, and validation rules
Implement Salesforce integrations with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, or third-party connectors
Lead and mentor junior Salesforce developers on coding standards, design patterns, and troubleshooting
Participate in technical planning, estimation, and code reviews
Ensure solutions follow Salesforce best practices and comply with security and performance requirements
Support data migration, sandbox deployment, and production rollout
Requirements:
3+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience
Proficiency in Apex, LWC, Flow Builder, and Salesforce DX
Experience working with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, or other Salesforce modules
Strong understanding of Salesforce platform architecture, security, and governor limits
Experience with integrating Salesforce with external systems (REST/SOAP APIs, middleware)
Familiarity with CI/CD tools for Salesforce (Gearset, Copado, Jenkins, etc.)
Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies
Salesforce Platform Developer I certification required (Developer II or Architect certs preferred)
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
Education: Bachelor's degree or above
Certifications:
Required: Salesforce Platform Developer I
Preferred: Platform Developer II, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, JavaScript Developer I, Sharing & Visibility Designer, Integration Architect
Bonus: Application Architect, System Architect (part of CTA path), Admin or Advanced Admin
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience working with public sector clients or in regulated environments
Prior experience in Salesforce Community Cloud / Experience Cloud
Knowledge of Data Loader, SOQL, and deployment tools
Background in JavaScript, HTML/CSS for LWC components
Familiarity with Salesforce AppExchange packages

If you are looking for an opportunity to grow your career while working on meaningful projects, we would love to hear from you!

 

Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice.
